title: Decision Logger Join
description: Bidirectional join between tool calls and DecisionContext records in <your-decision-store>.jsonl. Enables correlation of tool use with decision outcomes for ELO rating updates.

decision_id.description: ID of the DecisionContext that triggered this tool call. Format: dec_YYYYMMDD_HHmmss_NNNNNN. Null if no active decision context. Join key: <your-decision-store>.jsonl[decision_id] ↔ unified-activity.jsonl[metadata.decision.decision_id].

intent_classification.description: Mirrors DecisionContext.intent_classification for quick filtering without joining to decisions file.

entity_id.description: First 8 chars of SHA256(project_path). Matches EntityMemory.entity_id hashing pattern for privacy-preserving project identification. Null if no project context.

signal_type.description: Position of this tool call in the decision lifecycle. pre_decision: tool calls that inform the decision (Read, Grep). post_decision: actions taken after decision (Write, Bash). outcome: result signals (TaskUpdate status=completed).

parent_decision_id.description: For nested decisions (subagents spawned by Task calls). Null for top-level decisions. Enables decision tree reconstruction.

decision_domain.description: Domain classification for routing decision outcomes to KOTH subcategories. Null if unclassified.
